name: Why Space Is Locked
description: Rockets and space ships are the end of the road in Create Galore.

pages.title: Why Space Is Locked
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Every way off the planet needs a **Stellar Core**.
- A core takes **six prizes**, one from each big branch of the world.
- One core per vehicle is enough, and every prize can be found again.
- The **Road to the Stars** advancement tab tracks it all.

Rockets and space ships are the end of the road in Create Galore. You can't just build one whenever you like: every way off the planet needs a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#](), and a core needs one prize from each big branch of the world.

pages.title: The six prizes
pages.text:
- [#](2E5AAC)[Immortal Embryo](entry://stars/abyss)[#](): the deep sea
- [#](2E5AAC)[4 Fiery Ingots](entry://stars/twilight)[#](): Twilight Forest
- [#](2E5AAC)[4 Enchanted Gravitite](entry://stars/aether)[#](): the Aether
- [#](2E5AAC)[Nether Star](entry://stars/nether)[#](): the Nether
- [#](2E5AAC)[4 Dragonskin](entry://stars/end)[#](): the End
- [#](2E5AAC)[2 Circuit Boards](entry://stars/industry)[#](): heavy industry

pages.title: What it gates
pages.text:
All three ways up take a core:
- the Northstar [#](2E5AAC)[Rocket Station](entry://space/rocket_building)[#]()
- the [#](2E5AAC)[Dimensional Drive](entry://space/aeronautics_bridge)[#]()
- the **Stellar Navigator**

pages.title: One per vehicle
pages.text: Each of those blocks is placed once and reused trip after trip, so one core per vehicle is enough. Friends can share one rocket.

pages.title: No dead ends
pages.text: Nothing on this list comes from space, and nothing on Earth needs a space item to work. Every prize can be found again: bosses respawn or have more lairs, and ores keep generating further out. Titanium is made on Earth by [#](2E5AAC)[sequenced assembly](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]().

pages.title: Your checklist
pages.text:
Open Advancements and find the **Road to the Stars** tab. It ticks off each prize as you pick it up, then the core, then your first trip off Earth.\
\
The bosses can all be beaten with Create builds: see [#](2E5AAC)[Fighting with Machines](entry://stars/machine_fights)[#]().
